# log

Show commit history.

## JavaScript

```ts
git.log({ maxCount?: number, format?: string, author?: string, since?: string, revisionRange?: string })
```

## CLI

```bash
git --no-pager log [--max-count <max-count>] [--format=<format>] [--author <author>] [--since <since>] [<revision-range>]
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | CLI | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `maxCount` | `--max-count` | `number` | No | - | Limit the number of commits. |
| `format` | `--format` | `string` | No | - | Pretty-print format, for example "%H %s". |
| `author` | `--author` | `string` | No | - | Only commits by this author. |
| `since` | `--since` | `string` | No | - | Only commits newer than this date. |
| `revisionRange` | _positional_ | `string` | No | - | Revision or range, for example "main..HEAD". |

## Output

Parsed as `lines`. `result.data` is `string[]`. One entry per output line.

## Examples

**Last three subjects**

```ts
await git.log({
  maxCount: 3,
  format: '%s',
})
```

```bash
git --no-pager log --max-count 3 --format=%s
```
